(() => { const fs = [...document.querySelectorAll('div')].find(e => String(e.className).includes('fixed inset-0 z-50')); const lyr = [...fs.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => (b.getAttribute('aria-label')||'').includes('lời bài hát')); lyr.click(); return 'open'; })()
